# byoa

> byoa lets your app run each user's own Claude Code or Codex, on their plan and with their tools, in any sandbox, from inside your own backend.

byoa is an open-source library (Apache 2.0). It runs inside the app's own backend; it is not a hosted service. byoa is not on npm yet. Until version 1, install it from GitHub:

```sh
npm install github:madeyexz/byoa     # npm builds it on install
bun add github:madeyexz/byoa        # Bun loads its TypeScript source
```

## Docs

- [README: Who brings what](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#who-brings-what): what the app developer brings, what each end user brings, and where byoa runs
- [README: The problem](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#the-problem): the connection layer each AI-native app builds again
- [README: What byoa is, and what it is not](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#what-byoa-is-and-what-it-is-not): a library in your own backend, not a hosted service
- [README: Why byoa](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#why-byoa): the user's plan pays, the real agents, any sandbox, connect once
- [README: How it works](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#how-it-works): agents.run, the MCP proxy and job tokens, and a new sandbox for each job
- [README: Install](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#install): from GitHub until version 1; Node 22.18 or later, or Bun
- [README: Agent skill](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#agent-skill): a skill that teaches a coding agent to add byoa to an app
- [README: How it will look](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#how-it-will-look): the API: createAgents, connectLogin/finishLogin, connectMcp/finishMcp, agents.run and its events, agents.session, jobToken, importMcp, fetchWithGrant, the AI login options, Daytona and Convex
- [README: Test your app without a plan or a sandbox](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#test-your-app-without-a-plan-or-a-sandbox): the fake harness, the local sandbox and memoryStore; byoa's own tests
- [README: Example app](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#example-app): the to-do example on byoa
- [README: How we will verify it](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#how-we-will-verify-it): the checks that define version 1
- [README: Rules we follow](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#rules-we-follow): the labs' rules that byoa and every app on it follow
- [README: License](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/README.md#license): Apache 2.0
- [SPEC.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madeyexz/byoa/main/SPEC.md): the version 1 requirements (R1 to R7) and the checks (V1 to V12)
- [SPEC.md: Lab rules](https://github.com/madeyexz/byoa/blob/main/SPEC.md#lab-rules): what Anthropic's and OpenAI's terms allow, and what byoa and each app must do
- [Full docs](https://byoa.rippling.computer/llms-full.txt): the README, SPEC.md, the example and the skill in one file

## Example

- [examples/todo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madeyexz/byoa/main/examples/todo/README.md): an AI-native to-do list on byoa; its backend uses byoa in 35 lines
- [examples/todo/app.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madeyexz/byoa/main/examples/todo/app.ts): all of the example's byoa code, as one fetch handler

## Agent skill

- [skills/byoa/SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madeyexz/byoa/main/skills/byoa/SKILL.md): teaches a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Amp and others) to add byoa to an app
- [skills/byoa/reference/api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madeyexz/byoa/main/skills/byoa/reference/api.md): the API reference: every method, option and event
